preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of towns n in each test case must be between 1 and 40000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each total duration b_i in the input must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any_valid_a else stdout.startswith('YES')
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence a exists, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the sequence a.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: Each element a_i in the output sequence must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: sum((k + 1) * a_i for k in range(n)) == b_i for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: The total duration of concerts in each town must match the input values b_i.
